fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Cropped the base-game box from Ndemic Creations’ own retail launch graphic in its 2017 announcement https://www.ndemiccreations.com/en/news/125-scenario-creator-set-for-launch-board-game-hits-retail-and-shadow-plague-infects-ps4-and-xbox-one. This is the original English base game launched from the 2016 campaign, not the Armageddon expansion. Reduced to 265 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who washed their hands most recently starts.
clarifications: Starting DNA Points depend on turn order: the first player starts at 0, the second at 1, the third at 2, and the fourth at 3.
